instruction: Set user 2 privilege to admin level
Configure SOL privilege level via LAN plus
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password sol set 1 privilege-level admin

instruction: Check power status using LAN plus interface
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password chassis power status

instruction: Disable DNS from DHCP on NIC
Enable LAN access on channel 1 via LAN plus
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password lan set 1 access on
ipmitool -H 192.168.1.100 -U root -P calvin chassis power status

instruction: List temperature sensors via LAN plus
output: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.0.0.50 -U admin -P password sdr list temperature

instruction: Query all sensors via LAN with credentials
